title: [Feature Request]: AgentWorkflow should accept empty tool list
body:
### Feature Description

For a demo of a very simple agent I wanted to create an AgentWorkflow with no tools. Validation prevented me from doing this. Can we make it possible to do?

Repro: https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1McjGJ8R8yowzhA1Cg_Sn0gHNZqIzRHBo#scrollTo=4UK1-Pr4qItW

linked_prs.title: fix: tools param cannot be Null when calling Anthropic Messages API
linked_prs.body:
# Description

When the list of tools is empty, we pass `None` to Anthropic, which causes an HTTP 400 `invalid_request_error` .
With this PR, we now pass along the empty list.

Fixes #17920
